_comment: Standards reference. `status` is either 'verified' (cross-checked against a published source listed in sources) or 'needs-review'. A needs-review record is published deliberately — a knowledge base that hides its gaps is worse than one that marks them.

title.en: Mortise locks for doors — case dimensions and requirements
title.zh: 门用插芯锁——锁体尺寸与要求

scope.en: Mortise lock cases for timber, steel and tubular-frame doors. Defines case dimensions, backsets, follower size and classes 1–8 by duty.
scope.zh: 木门、钢门与管框门用插芯锁体。规定锁体尺寸、背距、方轴尺寸，并按用途分为 1–8 级。

en: Backset values — 55 mm and 60 mm are the standard ones; 45, 65, 70 and 80 mm also exist
Centre distance — 72 mm for interior doors, 92 mm for exterior doors; 78 mm on some series
Follower (spindle) size — 8 mm square
Faceplate sizes — 20 × 235 mm and 24 × 235 mm are the common ones
Duty class, which drives cycle life and fire performance
zh: 背距数值——55 mm 与 60 mm 为标准值，另有 45、65、70、80 mm
中心距——室内门 72 mm，外门 92 mm，部分系列为 78 mm
方轴尺寸——8 mm 方形
面板尺寸——常见 20 × 235 mm 与 24 × 235 mm
用途等级，决定循环寿命与耐火性能

whyItMattersForRetrofit.en: This is the single most useful document for anyone designing a European retrofit adapter, because it is what makes the parts interchangeable in the first place.
whyItMattersForRetrofit.zh: 对任何设计欧标改造适配件的人来说，这是最有用的文件，因为正是它让零件具备互换性。

sources.title: DIN 18251 deep dive — backsets, 72 mm centre distance, cylinder dimensions
CES datasheet citing DIN 18251-1 class 3 with 45–80 mm backsets

scope.en: The profile cylinder that plugs into a DIN 18251 case — the part every euro-cylinder retrofit grabs onto.
scope.zh: 插入 DIN 18251 锁体的槽型锁芯——所有欧标锁芯改造方案都要夹持的部件。

en: Profile cross-section, roughly 17 × 33 mm
Length in 5 mm steps, quoted as two halves from the fixing screw (30/10, 35/35, …)
Cam type and cam clock position
Double-clutch (emergency / hazard) function availability
zh: 槽型截面，约 17 × 33 mm
长度以 5 mm 递增，按中央固定螺钉分两段标注（30/10、35/35……）
凸轮型式与角度位置
是否具备双离合（应急）功能

whyItMattersForRetrofit.en: Every clamp-on retrofit motor needs a cylinder that protrudes enough and has an emergency function. Both are decided here.
whyItMattersForRetrofit.zh: 每个夹持式改造电机都需要突出足够且具备应急功能的锁芯，两者都由本标准决定。

sources.title: DIN 18251/18252 cylinder dimensions 17 × 33 × 10 mm

title.en: Mechanically operated locks and latching devices
title.zh: 机械操作锁具与锁扣装置

scope.en: The European umbrella standard for lock cases and latches, with an eight-digit classification code covering durability, door mass, suitability for fire doors, security, corrosion and operating temperature.
scope.zh: 欧洲锁体与锁扣装置的总括标准，用八位分类码表示耐久性、门重、防火门适用性、安全性、耐腐蚀与工作温度。

en: Cycle grades (0–8) and the corresponding duty
Whether the lock is suitable for use on fire/smoke door assemblies
Security grade and corrosion resistance
Centre distance and backset ranges recognised across Europe
zh: 循环等级（0–8）及其对应的使用强度
该锁是否适用于防火/防烟门组
安全等级与耐腐蚀等级
欧洲范围内认可的中心距与背距范围

whyItMattersForRetrofit.en: If the replacement lock loses the fire-door suitability of the original, the doorset's certification is broken even though everything fits mechanically.
whyItMattersForRetrofit.zh: 如果替换锁失去了原锁的防火门适用性，即使机械上完全装得上，门组的认证也已失效。

sources.title: Mortise locks: 72/85/92 mm centre distance, 45–80 mm backsets, fire ratings

scope.en: Classification for cylinder durability, key differing, corrosion, temperature and — importantly for retrofit — attack resistance.
scope.zh: 规定锁芯耐久性、钥匙差异数、耐腐蚀、温度，以及对改造尤为重要的抗攻击能力分级。

en: Attack resistance class, which is what a TS007 or Sold Secure rating sits on top of
Key differing and key control
Durability grade
zh: 抗攻击等级——TS007 与 Sold Secure 评级建立在其之上
钥匙差异数与钥匙管控
耐久性等级

whyItMattersForRetrofit.en: An integrated-cylinder smart lock must state its EN 1303 classification, otherwise the buyer cannot compare it with the cylinder it replaces.
whyItMattersForRetrofit.zh: 集成式锁芯智能锁必须标明 EN 1303 分级，否则买家无法与它替换掉的原锁芯作比较。

sources.title: Euro profile cylinder compliant with EN 1303

title.en: Fire resistance and smoke control tests for door and shutter assemblies
title.zh: 门与卷帘门组的耐火与防烟试验

scope.en: How a complete doorset — leaf, frame, hardware, seals — is fire tested. The lock is tested as part of the assembly, not alone.
scope.zh: 规定整套门组（门扇、门框、五金、密封）如何进行耐火试验。锁是作为整体的一部分受测，而非单独测试。

en: Whether a given lock is allowed on a fire-rated doorset
The fire rating of the assembly (30, 60, 90, 120 minutes)
That changing hardware changes the tested configuration
zh: 某款锁是否允许用于耐火门组
更换五金即改变了受测配置这一事实

whyItMattersForRetrofit.en: The number one way a well-intentioned smart lock retrofit becomes a liability: it fits perfectly and invalidates the door's certificate.
whyItMattersForRetrofit.zh: 这是好心的智能锁改造最常变成责任问题的地方：装得完美，却让门的认证失效。

sources.title: Fire-rated mortise locks: 30–240 minute requirements

title.en: Thief resistant locks operated by key from both sides
title.zh: 双面钥匙操作的防盗锁

scope.en: The lock standard most UK home insurers name. Applies to 5-lever mortice deadlocks and rim nightlatches on timber doors.
scope.zh: 英国多数家庭保险条款中点名的锁具标准。适用于木门上的五杆插芯锁与外装夜锁。

en: Minimum five levers — a three-lever lock can never comply
At least 1,000 key differs
Minimum 20 mm bolt throw into the frame
Hardened anti-drill plates and anti-pick features
Key required on both sides (no thumb-turn)
zh: 至少五片杠杆——三杆锁永远无法合规
至少 1,000 个钥匙差异
方舌伸入门框至少 20 mm
硬化防钻板与防技术开启结构
两面都需钥匙（无旋钮）

whyItMattersForRetrofit.en: The Kitemark is stamped on the faceplate, so a photo of the door edge answers the question. That makes this the easiest compliance check to automate from a photo.
whyItMattersForRetrofit.zh: Kitemark 印在面板上，因此一张门边照片就能回答问题。这使它成为最容易通过照片自动化的合规检查。

sources.title: What are BS3621 locks? — Master Locksmiths Association
British Standard locks explained

title.en: Thief resistant locks with keyless egress (thumb-turn or push-pad)
title.zh: 带免钥匙逃生的防盗锁（旋钮或按钮）

scope.en: Same attack resistance as BS 3621 but with keyless exit from inside. Expected on commercial premises, HMOs and flats where an escape route applies.
scope.zh: 抗攻击能力与 BS 3621 相同，但内侧可免钥匙开启。适用于有逃生通道要求的商业场所、合租屋与公寓。

en: Keyless egress from inside without a key
Same forced-entry resistance as BS 3621
Suitability where fire-escape rules apply
zh: 内侧免钥匙逃生
与 BS 3621 相同的抗强制开启能力
适用于消防逃生规则要求的场所

whyItMattersForRetrofit.en: Any smart retrofit on an escape route must preserve keyless egress. This standard is the clearest statement of that requirement in a lock specification.
whyItMattersForRetrofit.zh: 任何位于逃生通道上的智能改造都必须保留免钥匙逃生能力。在锁具规范中，本标准对该要求表述得最清晰。

sources.title: BS3621 vs BS8621 vs BS10621

title.en: Thief resistant locks lockable from outside only
title.zh: 仅可从外侧上锁的防盗锁

scope.en: A niche variant: the lock can be secured with a key from outside but not locked from inside. Used where internal locking must be prevented.
scope.zh: 较小众的变体：可从外侧用钥匙上锁，但不能从内侧上锁。用于必须防止内侧上锁的场所。

en: Outside key locking only
Same attack resistance family as BS 3621 / BS 8621
zh: 仅外侧钥匙上锁
与 BS 3621 / BS 8621 同一抗攻击体系

whyItMattersForRetrofit.en: Rare, but it explains why some doors cannot accept a motor that also locks: the specification deliberately forbids inside locking.
whyItMattersForRetrofit.zh: 较少见，但它解释了为什么有些门不能装带自动上锁功能的电机：规范本身就禁止内侧上锁。

sources.title: British Standard locks explained

title.en: Enhanced security cylinder standard (1, 2 or 3 star)
title.zh: 增强安全锁芯标准（一星、二星、三星）

scope.en: The Kitemark standard for cylinders on uPVC and composite doors, aimed at lock snapping. Current edition cited as DHF TS 007-1:2024.
scope.zh: 用于 uPVC 与复合门锁芯的 Kitemark 标准，主要针对锁芯折断攻击。当前版本被引用为 DHF TS 007-1:2024。

en: Star rating for snapping, picking, bumping and drilling resistance
That a 1-star cylinder needs a 2-star handle to be an acceptable combination
That a 3-star cylinder is compliant on its own
zh: 针对折断、技术开启、撞击与钻孔的星级评定
一星锁芯需搭配二星把手才构成可接受的组合
三星锁芯单独即合规

whyItMattersForRetrofit.en: Retrofitting a smart lock onto an unrated cylinder keeps the weakest component. The right advice pairs the motor with a 3-star cylinder.
whyItMattersForRetrofit.zh: 在没有等级的锁芯上加装智能锁，等于保留最薄弱的部件。正确的建议是电机搭配三星锁芯。

sources.title: TS007 explained, including the 1-star + 2-star combination
TS 007-1:2024 referenced as the current edition

title.en: Sold Secure cylinder scheme (Bronze, Silver, Diamond)
title.zh: Sold Secure 锁芯认证（铜、银、钻石）

scope.en: An independent testing scheme for cylinders. Diamond passes attack tests beyond what TS007 3-star covers and is referenced by Secured by Design.
scope.zh: 独立的锁芯测试认证。钻石级通过的测试超出 TS007 三星范围，并被 Secured by Design 引用。

en: Attack resistance beyond TS007
Recognition by police Secured by Design schemes
Often required alongside or instead of TS007 by insurers
zh: 超出 TS007 的抗攻击能力
被警方 Secured by Design 体系认可
保险公司常要求与 TS007 并列或替代

whyItMattersForRetrofit.en: Two certification marks can appear on one cylinder. Record both — they are not interchangeable.
whyItMattersForRetrofit.zh: 同一把锁芯上可能出现两种认证标记。两者都要记录，它们不可互换。

sources.title: Sold Secure SS312 Diamond explained

title.en: Bored and preassembled locks and latches
title.zh: 开孔式与预装锁具及锁扣

scope.en: The knob and lever sets fitted through a cross bore. Grades 1, 2 and 3 by durability and strength.
scope.zh: 通过横孔安装的球形锁与把手锁。按耐久与强度分为 1、2、3 级。

en: Cycle life by grade. Allegion lists 1,000,000 / 400,000 / 200,000; other published tables give 800,000 for Grade 1 — cite the edition when quoting
Impact resistance (hammer blows) by grade
Backset 2-3/8 in or 2-3/4 in, cross bore 2-1/8 in
Function designations (passage, privacy, entry, storeroom, classroom)
zh: 按等级的循环寿命。Allegion 给出 1,000,000 / 400,000 / 200,000；另有公开表格给出 Grade 1 为 800,000——引用时须注明版本
按等级的抗冲击（锤击）能力
功能代号（通道、隐私、入户、库房、教室）

whyItMattersForRetrofit.en: Because the bores are standardised, this is the family where a smart lockset can be specified without seeing the door.
whyItMattersForRetrofit.zh: 由于孔位标准化，这是唯一可以不看门就指定智能锁组的锁族。

sources.title: Allegion — ANSI/BHMA grade cycle counts (A156.2: 1,000,000 / 400,000 / 200,000)
ANSI/BHMA grades explained, backset and cross bore (Grade 1 quoted as 800,000)

scope.en: Commercial mortise locksets. Allegion lists 1,000,000 cycles at Grade 1 and 800,000 at Grades 2 and 3.
scope.zh: 商用插芯锁组。Allegion 给出 Grade 1 为 1,000,000 次循环，Grade 2 与 3 均为 800,000 次。

en: Cycle life by grade
Case dimensions and prep
Function range, which is far wider than residential
zh: 按等级的循环寿命
锁体尺寸与开孔
功能范围，远宽于住宅用

whyItMattersForRetrofit.en: Commercial doors usually already have access control. Retrofit means integrating, not replacing.
whyItMattersForRetrofit.zh: 商用门通常已有门禁系统。改造意味着集成，而不是替换。

sources.title: Allegion — A156.13 cycle counts

title.zh: 辅助锁及相关产品（插销锁）

scope.en: The standard behind the American deadbolt — the lock that most retrofit smart locks are built around.
scope.zh: 美制插销锁背后的标准——多数改造型智能锁正是围绕它设计的。

en: Minimum 1 in (25.4 mm) bolt throw for bored locks, all grades
Maximum key / turn / knob torque of 11 lbf·in (1.2 N·m), all grades
Maximum lever force of 3.6 N; force to latch 24 N
Endurance load: dead bolt 6,000 / 5,000 / 3,000 N by grade
zh: 开孔式锁的最小方舌行程 1 英寸（25.4 mm），各级相同
钥匙 / 旋钮最大扭矩 11 lbf·in（1.2 N·m），各级相同
把手最大作用力 3.6 N；上锁力 24 N

whyItMattersForRetrofit.en: The 1.2 N·m torque cap is the number a retrofit motor's gearbox is designed against. Exceeding it on a compliant lock means the design is wrong, not the lock.
whyItMattersForRetrofit.zh: 1.2 N·m 的扭矩上限正是改造电机减速箱的设计依据。在合规锁上超过它，说明设计有问题，而不是锁有问题。

sources.title: ANSI/BHMA A156.36-2010 text — torque, force, cycle and endurance tables

scope.en: Electrified locksets, strikes and exit devices — the correct path when a door already has power and access control. Designation to be re-confirmed against the current BHMA catalogue.
scope.zh: 电动锁组、电插与逃生装置——当门已有供电与门禁时的正确路径。标准编号需对照 BHMA 现行目录再次确认。

en: Fail-safe versus fail-secure behaviour
Electrical ratings and monitoring
Egress compliance for electrified hardware
zh: 失电开启与失电上锁行为
电气额定值与状态监测
电动五金的逃生合规性

whyItMattersForRetrofit.en: A battery motor on a door that already has power is usually the wrong answer.
whyItMattersForRetrofit.zh: 在已有供电的门上使用电池电机，通常是错误答案。

sources.title: To be confirmed — BHMA standards list

title.en: Certificate of Conformity for fire-rated doorsets

scope.en: Singapore's fire authority requires a Certificate of Conformity for fire-rated doorsets, commonly tested by SETSCO or TÜV SÜD. HDB units near lift lobbies or staircases commonly require 30 or 60 minutes.
scope.zh: 新加坡消防机构要求耐火门组具备符合性证书，常由 SETSCO 或 TÜV SÜD 测试。靠近电梯厅或楼梯的 HDB 单位通常要求 30 或 60 分钟。

en: Whether the doorset keeps its fire rating after a lock change
30 or 60 minute rating for HDB main doors
That the certificate covers the doorset, not the lock in isolation
zh: 换锁后门组是否仍保持耐火等级
HDB 主门的 30 或 60 分钟等级
证书覆盖的是整套门组，而非单独的锁

whyItMattersForRetrofit.en: A lock supplier claiming 'fire certified' may hold a component certificate only. Ask for the doorset CoC number and the issuing body.
whyItMattersForRetrofit.zh: 声称“防火认证”的锁具供应商可能只持有部件证书。要索取门组 CoC 编号与发证机构。

sources.title: HDB digital lock guide — SETSCO / TÜV SÜD certification, 30-minute rating
HDB door lock upgrade — Certificate of Conformity and 42–50 mm fire-rated leaves

scope.en: Published as a placeholder: Australian locking devices are covered by an AS/NZS standard whose exact designation we have not yet cross-checked. Do not cite this record until a contributor confirms it.
scope.zh: 此条为占位：澳洲锁具由某项 AS/NZS 标准覆盖，其确切编号我们尚未交叉核对。在贡献者确认前请勿引用本条目。

en: To be confirmed by a contributor familiar with AS/NZS hardware standards
zh: 待熟悉 AS/NZS 五金标准的贡献者确认

whyItMattersForRetrofit.en: Australia is a large market with its own case geometry; the gap here is a priority for contributors.
whyItMattersForRetrofit.zh: 澳洲市场大且有自成一套的锁体几何；此处的空缺是贡献者优先项。

sources.title: Open issue: confirm the AS/NZS designation for mechanical locking devices

scope.en: Published as a placeholder. Japanese lock cases are usually specified by maker part number; the applicable JIS designation for the hardware itself is not yet confirmed in this catalog.
scope.zh: 此条为占位。日本锁体通常按厂商料号指定；适用于五金本身的 JIS 编号在本目录中尚未确认。

en: To be confirmed by a contributor in Japan
zh: 待日本贡献者确认

whyItMattersForRetrofit.en: Until the designation is confirmed, use maker part numbers as the interchange key for Japanese doors.
whyItMattersForRetrofit.zh: 在编号确认前，日本门请以厂商料号作为互换依据。

sources.title: Open issue: confirm the JIS designation covering door hardware
